title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Excellent Charlie Miller soundboard capture of a stellar 1969 Ark show featuring a rare folky opener, soaring Dark Star and a triumphant Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The April 23‑69 performance is hailed as one of the band’s finest early shows, opening with the seldom‑played “He Was A Friend Of Mine,” launching into a magnificent Dark Star, and delivering an eagerly awaited Morning Dew. Charlie Miller’s transfer delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality, with only a brief glitch noted in the St. Stephen → It’s A Sin segue.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (7‑plus) are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the recording; only minor criticisms (a single cut) appear, yielding an overall top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix praised as a “Super ’69 Soundboard” and “Audio Masterpiece"; one reviewer notes a brief cut in the St. Stephen → It’s A Sin transition.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with a quiet, folky opener that builds into high‑energy jams; the set is packed with extended improvisations and seamless segues, delivering a dynamic arc that keeps momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “climbing like an eagle” with soaring guitar work during Dark Star and other jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned for his witty banter about the Morning Dew request; no specific musical critique.
